text:
maya: Heads-up — scheduling a pen test week of Apr 12. Need RBAC freeze window, KMS readroom access plan, and audit-log export checklist. Scope: hosted API, Dedicated control plane, Console dashboards. Assessor will need KMS usage proofs, role-change diffs, and retention evidence. Any blockers?

sam: +1. Propose RBAC freeze 2024-04-10T00:00Z -> 2024-04-14T23:59Z. Emergency role changes only via ops oncall. :calendar:

lucas: Lock service-account rotations that week. Create ephemeral role `pt_assessor` with kms:Decrypt on artifacts prefix + CloudTrail read. Pushing policy draft.

tina: Audit plan: snapshot CloudTrail + redwood-audit stream, sign tarball, upload to evidence bucket with sha256, presigned URL. Retention proof needed: 1y. I'll run dry-run export.

assessor-bot: Checklist uploaded: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-pt-readiness/checklist.md — needs evidence manifest, readroom creds, and queryable log dumps. Confirm when ready.

maya: Action items: @lucas IAM+KMS policy draft; @sam set freeze calendar + emergency rollback runbook; @tina dry-run export + sample logs; @maya coordinate compliance evidence manifest.

lucas: IAM policy draft (PR incoming):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/pt-key","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:ViaService":"s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com"}}},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"}
  ]
}
```
Key policy will restrict to pt_assessor and log Decrypts.

sam: Remediation tracking: single JIRA epic PT-REM-1749995555 + per-finding subtasks. Labels security:pen-test, severity:P0/P1/P2. Can infra webhook auto-create issues from triage sheet?

tina: Webhook ok. Require PoF in each ticket + one log query per fix. Retest opens 72h after fix validated by ops+sec-review.

maya: Provide a staging readroom (synthetic data, no prod credentials) with pre-baked dataset and mocked tokens for repro.

ops-oncall: We'll disable autoscale-out for API during window and add rate-limits. Alert suppression rule ps-20240412 for noisy LB alerts. Any side-effects? ping @lucas

lucas: OK. Adding CloudWatch metric filter for kms:Decrypt with principal=pt_assessor. Tag logs with pt_run:1749995555.

tina: Dry-run sample logs:
```
2024-04-03T15:12:03Z account=123456 event=Encrypt kms_action=Encrypt key=pt-key principal=serviceA requestId=abc-123
2024-04-03T15:13:11Z account=123456 event=Decrypt kms_action=Decrypt key=pt-key principal=pt_assessor requestId=def-456
```
sha256:3b7f...fa2

sam: Emergency rollback snippet for runbook:
```bash
# ops only
kubectl --context=prod rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=<last-known-good>
```
Requires sec-eng + PM signoff.

maya: Timeline: kickoff Mon Apr 8 15:00 PT. Freeze as proposed. Lucas/Tina/Sam update evidence board by Fri Apr 5 with PRs + dry-run. I'll loop in compliance.

tina: Will attach dry-run tarball and post presigned URL to tracker.

assessor-bot: Noted. Attach key policy diff, IAM policy, log tarball, and a sample query per finding. We'll schedule scoping after uploads.

maya: Thanks all — will send calendar invites. Ping here for blockers :+1:
